value.rationale: The source universal backward-error convergence result uses a conservative eta<=1/||A||. The exact optimized envelope quantifies a dimension- and conditioning-independent advantage of overrelaxation for finite budgets, shows the maximum step preserving the original all-horizon guarantee is 1+1/sqrt(3), and distinguishes inconsistent singular and high-frequency oscillatory extremizers. It changes practical stepsize decisions for matrix-only backward-error stopping and is neither a renamed fixed-SPD spectral-radius result nor a single arbitrary numerical example.
